purpose: Teach Astronomicon to inspect Patch Packs and compare declared expected outputs against actual receipts without executing anything.

verdicts.CLOSED_BY_DECLARED_GOALS: Declared expected verdict/receipts are present and actual receipts support the declared goal at smoke level.
verdicts.PARTIAL: Some expected outputs exist but the declared goal is not fully supported.
verdicts.FAILED: Expected outputs contradict or fail the declared goal.
verdicts.UNPROVEN_RECEIPT_ONLY: Receipts exist, but they do not prove stated pass goals or expected verdicts.
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_DECLARATION: Patch Pack lacks enough declared goals/expected receipts/verdict to judge closure.
verdicts.NOT_A_PATCH_PACK: Folder does not satisfy basic Patch Pack shape.

hard_laws: receipt existence is not task completion proof
Patch Pack smoke validation must not execute runner
Patch Pack smoke validation is not Custodes trust
Patch Pack smoke validation is not Throne verdict
Patch Pack smoke validation can only compare declaration against evidence
SERVITOR Task Pack law must not be confused with Patch Pack law
Intake Draft can inform expectations but cannot become Valid Task Pack here
minimum_patch_pack_shape: runner ps1 or explicit no-runner declaration
FILES_TO_LAND directory or explicit no-land declaration
